questions.background: A five-wicket haul means that a bowler takes at least five wickets in a single innings.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Resolve to the first West Indies bowler to reach five wickets in a single innings during the opening Test against Pakistan in Tarouba in July 2026, according to the match scorecard and contemporaneous match reporting. Frontline seamers still hold ~71% combined share given Trinidad pace pedigree, overcast/rain-freshened conditions, and low bounce seen in Abbas's wicket: local spearhead Jayden Seales trims 0.34 -> 0.31, express quick Shamar Joseph trims 0.30 -> 0.26, and accurate stump-to-stump veteran Kemar Roach (11 career Test 5-fors, well suited to low bounce) edges up 0.13 -> 0.14. Top-5 sum = 0.98.

questions.title: Who will be appointed Peru's foreign minister in the incoming presidential administration's first cabinet in July 2026?
questions.background: A new presidential administration is scheduled to take office in Peru in July 2026. Its foreign minister will oversee the country's diplomatic relations.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official Peruvian government announcements or contemporaneous reporting by established news organizations. Resolution Condition : Resolve to the person officially appointed minister of foreign affairs in the incoming administration's first cabinet, with the appointment announced by July 31, 2026. Speculation about potential appointments does not count. Accepted Answer Format : The appointed foreign minister's full name.
questions.current_reasoning: 2026-07-25 major conflicting Peruvian cabinet leak update (Infobae Peru July 25 citing Esta Noche con Milagros Leiva July 24 night broadcast; LP Derecho July 24; El Buho July 23): While El Buho confirms Keiko Fujimori maintains 'total hermetismo' ahead of swearing in her first cabinet on July 28, two nearly identical cabinet lists surfaced July 24-25 (both naming Luis Galarreta for PCM, Cesar Astudillo for Interior, Rafael Belaunde Llosa for Defense, Guillermo Shinno/Pedro Sanchez for Energy & Mines, Juan Sheput for Labor, Rafael Rey for Transport, and Cecilia Bakula for Culture)—but split sharply on Foreign Affairs. LP Derecho (July 24) still listed former Si Creo candidate Carlos Espa for Relaciones Exteriores, consistent with July 13-19 El Comercio/Gestion/Gato Encerrado reporting and Si Creo Senate candidate Carla Mares sitting on Fujimori's Torre Tagle transfer team (ETTE). However, Infobae (July 25, 09:14 AM EST) summarizing Fuerza Popular-connected journalist Milagros Leiva's 'casi confirmada' July 24 night TV list explicitly reported that for Relaciones Exteriores 'el nombre que mas fuerza cobra es el de Carlos Pareja, un diplomatico cuya experiencia y cercania con la embajada de Estados Unidos genero comentarios, aunque se valoro su perfil politico y capacidad de gestion.' Retaining incumbent career-diplomat Foreign Minister and former Ambassador to the US Carlos Pareja aligns directly with El Comercio's July 19 warning about Torre Tagle diplomatic pushback and China-rhetoric veto risk against Espa, though minor ambiguity remains (Infobae's 'cercania con la embajada de Estados Unidos' / 'perfil politico' partially echoes Espa's profile, and Leiva noted some portfolios remain unclosed). Weighting both strong competing signals ahead of official confirmation: Carlos Espa trims 0.53 -> 0.37 (narrow #1 on structural ETTE + multi-outlet backing), while Carlos Pareja surges 0.03 -> 0.31 on Milagros Leiva/Infobae's fresh July 24-25 Fuerza Popular leak. Career/former-FM fallbacks trim slightly: Hugo de Zela (0.07 -> 0.06), Javier Gonzalez-Olaechea (0.07 -> 0.05; El Buho July 23 noted the earlier list naming him has changed), and Elmer Schialer (0.04 unchanged). Top-5 sum = 0.83, preserving 0.17 for another Torre Tagle ambassador or surprise July 27-28 unveiling.
